summary.text: Daniel Furman is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Peter Bixby.
Furman also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Furman was the Republican candidate for Strafford 13 in 2024, losing the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Peter Bixby, 1,568 votes (53.8%) to 1,345 (46.2%).
